A.name: Calm deadpan explainer
A.style: Calm, matter-of-fact, slightly deadpan narrator of a viral 3D-animated explainer Short. Quick but unhurried, even energy, never hyped. Let the facts be the surprise. Tiny pauses before reveals, a dry hint of a smirk. Cool, nonchalant, curious. Around 165 to 175 words a minute.

B.name: Punchy Shorts host
B.style: Bright, punchy, fast YouTube Shorts host. Every sentence lands with crisp emphasis and rising energy into each reveal, but it stays conversational, never shouting. Quick breaths, almost no dead air. Around 175 to 185 words a minute.

C.name: Cool with a punch
C.style: Mostly cool, nonchalant and confident, like telling a friend a wild fact without trying too hard, then a quick, sharp punch of energy on the big reveal lines before settling back. Engaging and fun, never over the top. Around 165 to 175 words a minute.
